purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Tiaty Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 200 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This is a 4-page form; page 3 (form sub-page 04/12) carries both the standard column headers (Odinga, Ruto, Waihiga, Wajackoyah, Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots) and the final shaded green TOTAL row, auto-located by green-shading pixel detection. Standard column order was independently confirmed by also reading the page 1 header block (form sub-page 02/12), since a prior constituency in this session (Mosop) used a non-standard column order and every subsequent row's candidate order is now checked against a visible header rather than assumed. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt), so all values were read visually from the rendered page image and independently cross-confirmed with a separate 400 DPI crop of the TOTAL row. The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (auto-located by green-shading pixel detection, scripts/p23/find_total_row.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
